description: This file contains Python scripts related to fetching external pull request statistics from GitHub API for the PyTorch repository, processing this data, and uploading it to S3 storage. It includes functions for URL fetching, JSON data retrieval, data aggregation over date ranges, and command-line argument parsing for scheduled execution.
